newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Sept manufacturers' shipments rise 0.8 pct. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Canada Sept manufacturers' shipments rise 0.8 pct. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]

text.p: Canadian manufacturers' shipments rose 0.8 percent in September to C$34.29 billion seasonally adjusted from C$34.02 billion in August, Statistics Canada said on Monday.
(Corrects month percentage figure for new orders to +0.1 pct from +1.2 pct)
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast shipments to rise 0.6 percent, unfilled orders to rise 0.1 percent, new orders to rise 0.5 percent and an inventory/shipment ratio of 1.31.

Statistics Canada said the largest increase in shipments came from the electrical and electronic products industry. Shipments of motor vehicles, refined petroleum and coal products also rose in September.
Increases took place in 14 of 22 major industry groups, accounting for slightly over 60 percent of total shipments.
The increase in inventories for the second month in a row may indicate that recent declines may have been enough to bring inventories in line with shipments, Statistics Canada said.
